name: comp-97
blurb: Circular icon button with semantic aria-label.
description: A Button with rounded-full class and size='icon', wrapping a Plus icon with an aria-label for accessibility.
use_when: You need a circular icon button that is accessible without text.
avoid_when: When multiple icon buttons are in sequence without visual differentiation.
a11y: aria-label on the button provides semantic meaning; icon is aria-hidden.
